claim.value: Removal tests must hold the equipment, agreed start deadline and other test conditions fixed.
claim.scope: Comparison of tested reductions within the selected case.

provenance.rationale: P009 explicitly requires these controls; P008 identifies the selected case.

signal_basis.value: Group or complement removal tests keep other conditions fixed and apply the same repetition rule; a smaller configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals cease to do so. Inconsistent or uncertain outcomes remain unresolved.
signal_basis.scope: Controlled comparisons among configurations of the selected case.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans supply the comparison operation, common repetition rule, unresolved-outcome handling and observed pattern.
The claim is supported as a procedural control requirement; no unresolved empirical relation is needed.

rationale: Holding nonremoved conditions fixed makes the configurations comparable: otherwise changes in equipment, deadline or background conditions could account for differences in lateness. This licenses the stated control requirement within the selected case.
uncertainty: Other test conditions are not enumerated, but that does not undermine the bounded requirement to hold them fixed.
